name_cn: 河北翰林纺织有限公司
main_products: Shirting fabric, TR uniform and suiting fabric, rayon/viscose, cotton twill, denim, chiffon, yarn-dyed fabric
woven_evidence: Its About page lists 200 air-jet, 100 water-jet, 200 shuttle and 100 rapier looms, which are all weaving looms.

canton_fair.evidence_note: A texnet.com.cn report on the 137th Canton Fair names 河北翰林纺织有限公司 among the 90+ Shijiazhuang textile exhibitors. The company's own site also says it exhibits at the Canton Fair every year.

notes: It claims a factory of more than 100 acres in Gaocheng and an output of 40M+ m a year. It names Saudi Arabia among its markets and has a Dubai office. Its MIC page mentions printed jersey stock held in Shaoxing warehouses (a minor knit line). Contacts: admin@hanlinfabric.com, +86 15830978534 (WeChat and WhatsApp).
